cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a futuristic orbital hydroponic fruit orchard — she rests after carrying a basket of spare fruit for the crew; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — standing; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a modern planetarium outreach corner after a show — she playfully demonstrates a star-map fold for visitors off camera; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a wooden sauna and cold plunge with a cooling lounge — holds a towel folded against her chest; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a walled garden with a lotus pond — sweeps the floor beside her with a small hand brush; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — standing; a Three Kingdoms festival street — carries a pipa lute by its neck at her side; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — swimming breaststroke
